name: Performance & Mobile Optimization

Verified with pnpm lint, pnpm typecheck, and pnpm build on 2026-05-05. Full WebP/AVIF acceptance remains deferred until real production photos exist; see docs/exec-plans/tech-debt-tracker.md.

Heavy components (story sections, gallery) lazy-loaded with next/dynamic
Mobile-first responsive design verified on 375px, 414px, 768px viewports
No layout shifts on image load
notes: This is a cross-cutting feature. Apply optimizations incrementally as other features are built.
